descriptions.zh:
实际上[Root.GetName]对旧式结构体系统的狂热探查已经适得其反了。

在古老电路彻底熔断之前，[Root.GetName]设法远程启动了轨道站的变位推进器——及时的将其踢出了原有轨道，使其进入了该行星的重力井中。这次任务的不幸结果对从这一经历中成长起来的指挥官[Root.GetLeaderName]产生了深远的影响。
descriptions.en:
It appears as if the [Root.GetName]'s enthusiastic probing of the old construct's systems has, quite literally, backfired.

Before the ancient circuits finally fried, the [Root.GetName] managed to remotely activate the orbital station's positional thrusters - promptly knocking it out of its gentle orbit and into the star's gravity well. The mission's unfortunate outcome has had a profound impact on the ship's commander, [Root.GetLeaderName], who has grown from the experience.

descriptions.zh: 在调查飞船和船员的残骸后，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]推测船员们一定是自相残杀。太空旅行的孤独与禁闭甚至可以击溃最强大的意志。
descriptions.en: Having searched the ship and inspected the crew's remains, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has deduced that the crewmembers must have killed each other. The solitude and confinement of space travel can break even the strongest of minds.

descriptions.zh: 我们未能阻止[From.From.GetName]上的飞舰载人工智能。他们的古船飞向遥远的天际，按照程序参数寻找下一个战场。
descriptions.en: We were unable to stall the fleet AI on [From.From.GetName]. Their ancient ships are taking to the skies and beyond, looking for the next battle according to their programmed parameters.

label.en: The rage of the machine is worth fearing.

descriptions.zh: 一切都太迟了，我们未能阻止前进的钻头。它钻得太深，最后被重重的岩石压碎。
descriptions.en: We could not stop the rampaging drill before it was too late. It dug too deep and was eventually crushed under the weight of rocky detritus of its own creation.

descriptions.zh: [From.From.From.GetName]的修复工程传来坏消息。建筑工人未能修理坏掉的机器，机器开始自行解体，已经无法修理了。
descriptions.en: Bad news from the repairs project on [From.From.From.GetName]. The construction workers have not been able to fix the broken machine, as it has started to break down even further and seems to be beyond repair.

descriptions.zh: 很遗憾，未能抢救靠近[From.From.From.GetName]的漂流船。一个未侦测到的小行星突然出现在碰撞航向上，把那艘船撞成了碎片。
descriptions.en: Sadly we were not able to save the drifting ship close to [From.From.From.GetName] before it was too late. An untracked asteroid appeared on a collision course and smashed the ship to pieces.

descriptions.zh:
被怪兽侵袭的飞船发来了最后的电报。那些野兽已经成功突破到了船员藏身的地方。

情况太过残忍，就不多做描述了。没有生还者。
descriptions.en:
A last transmission has been received from the monster-infested ship. It tells us that the beast succeeded in getting through to the crew's hiding place.

The horrid encounter was far too graphic to describe. There were no survivors.

descriptions.zh: 十分可惜，我们的语言学家未能完全理解[From.From.From.GetName]上古老文献的外星语言。不过，他们翻译了一些核心内容，让我们得以窥探那个文明的文化。
descriptions.en: Sadly our linguists have been unable to understand the entirety of the alien language used in the old documents found on [From.From.From.GetName]. However, they managed to translate the essentials, which has given us a glimpse into the culture they originated from.

descriptions.zh: 在[WarriorHomePlanet.GetName]的地下避难所附近清除野兽时，战斗意外地导致了建筑崩塌。我们未能从残骸中回收到有价值的东西。
descriptions.en: Fighting off the beasts around the underground vault on [WarriorHomePlanet.GetName] has caused the complex to collapse. We are unable to salvage anything of value from the debris.

descriptions.zh: 打开[WarriorHomePlanet.GetName]上发现的容器后，我们找到了一些健康作物的样本，还有一些辅助器材，这可以让样本在肥沃条件下重新生长。我们可以用逆向工程技术研究它。
descriptions.en: Opening up the container we found on [WarriorHomePlanet.GetName] revealed it to hold samples of healthy crops, as well as instruments that would help it grow again in infertile conditions. We could reverse engineer this.

descriptions.zh:
打开[WarriorHomePlanet.GetName]上发现的容器后，我们找到了一些健康作物的样本，还有一些辅助器材，这可以让样本在肥沃条件下重新生长。.

虽然意义不大，但这个文明的文化历史数据可以让我们更了解他们的真面目。
descriptions.en:
Opening up the container we found on [WarriorHomePlanet.GetName] revealed it to hold samples of healthy crops, as well as instruments that would help it grow again in infertile conditions..

While not being that useful to us, there were also data on the civilization's culture and history, which could give us more insight into who they were.

descriptions.zh:
打开[WarriorHomePlanet.GetName]上发现的容器后，我们才意识到那是一个生物武器的发射器。

这种生物武器专门降低目标的生殖能力，并且扩散迅速。不过和我们的遗传因子不兼容，所以不会影响我们种群的数量。
descriptions.en:
After opening the container we found on [WarriorHomePlanet.GetName] we were shocked to realize that it was a dispenser for a biological weapon!

The bio-weapon was made to target fertility functions and quickly spreads. It is however not entirely compatible with our DNA, and will not cause us to diminish in numbers.

tooltips.zh: §Y你的帝国§!获得§R抑制繁衍生物武器§!的修正。
tooltips.en: §YYour Empire§! gains the §RFertility Inhibiting Bio-Weapon§! modifier.

descriptions.zh: 根据辐射读数，这不是我们要寻找的恒星系。
descriptions.en: The radiation readings indicate that this is not the solar system we were looking for.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]上的气体开采设施已经化为一片火海。据报道，那种高度易燃的气体遇到了明火，导致了许多设施的爆炸！经过一连串的连锁反应，几乎炸光了我们侦探到的所有气体矿藏。

不能再犯同样的错误了。
descriptions.en:
The gas mining facility on [From.GetName] has turned into a burning inferno. The report says that the highly volatile gas was exposed an open flame, causing multiple facilities to explode! This in turn caused a chain reaction and blew up most of the gas caches we had located.

This backlash cannot be allowed to be repeated.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]上的气体开采设施已经化为一片火海。据报道，那种高度易燃的气体遇到了明火，导致了许多设施的爆炸！经过一连串的连锁反应，几乎炸光了我们侦探到的所有气体矿藏。

我们会缅怀在爆炸中死去的同胞。
descriptions.en:
The gas mining facility on [From.GetName] has turned into a burning inferno. The report says that the highly volatile gas was exposed an open flame, causing multiple facilities to explode! This in turn caused a chain reaction and blew up most of the gas caches we had located.

The people who died in the explosion won't be forgotten.

descriptions.zh: 我们从[Root.GetName]收到了求救信号。船员开始发疯地互相残杀！舰长已经失去控制，派船救援已经来不及了。这和他们刚刚调查的古船有关吗？
descriptions.en: We are receiving a distress signal from the [Root.GetName]. The crew has gone mad and are killing each other! The captain has lost all control, sending help would be futile at this point. Could this have anything to do with that derelict ship they recently investigated?
